name: Acid Splash
summary: A cantrip that bursts an acidic bubble in a 5-foot-radius Sphere, dealing Acid damage.

stats.effect: You create an acidic bubble at a point within range, where it explodes in a 5-foot-radius {ref:glossary/sphere}. Each creature in that Sphere must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d6 Acid damage.
stats.cantripUpgrade: The damage increases by 1d6 when you reach levels 5 (2d6), 11 (3d6), and 17 (4d6).
